positions.statement: In a December 2023 OPB interview as an Oregon City school board member, Stroh spoke about acting on fentanyl risks before a school incident occurs.
positions.excerpt: I don’t want to wait for the first accident to happen in our school before we do something.

positions.statement: Stroh lists public safety as a priority: fully fund law enforcement and restore consequences.
positions.excerpt: PUBLIC SAFETY: Fully fund law enforcement; restore real consequences.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Stroh lists education as a priority: restore academic standards and hold schools accountable for results.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 42

positions.statement: Stroh lists housing as a priority: cut bureaucracy and make homeownership a reality.

positions.statement: Stroh says it is time Oregon got serious about addiction and recovery.
